§6Antischrabidium§f

§aThe antimatter equivalent of schrabidium. Now with 50% more schrabidium. Yes, really.§f

§bAntischrabidium§f is the gaseous antimatter form of schrabidium. Same storage rules as antimatter: magnetic containment barrels only. It is the precursor to dark matter and thus euphemium.

§6Make It§f (Particle Accelerator, score §e400§f):
§b•§f 2x Antimatter Capsule -> §eAntischrabidium Capsule§f (empty capsule returned)

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bDark Matter Capsule§f, 2x antischrabidium (score §e10,000§f) in accelerator
§b•§f §bVibrant Singularity§f, for AMS/DFC core
§b•§f §bSingularity§f, euphemium nuggets + antischrabidium + schrabidium block
§b•§f §bCMB-Schrabidate Laser Crystal§f, ferric schrabidate + antischrabidium + CMB steel
§b•§f §bSchrabidium Missile§f, small missile assembly + antischrabidium cell
§b•§f Cyclotron alternative: Box of Plutonium Dust + Antimatter Cell

§ePS:§f The chain is: antimatter -> antischrabidium -> dark matter -> euphemium. Each dark matter capsule eats 2 antischrabidium, which eat 4 antimatter. Your accelerator will be busy.
